description: Alpha promotion lifecycle golden (iap.lifecycle). `config` is the merged policy (configs/strategies/lifecycle.json + strategies.json adaptive.lifecycle); `transition_table` the allowed edges with their gates in evaluation order; `states` the integer ids; each scenario lists per step the action, the input evidence, and the expected state / outcome / gate results / counters / transition after it. Generated by python/tools/make_golden_lifecycle.py; every port reproduces every step exactly (states, booleans and decimals are exact; no tolerance).

LC01.note: research result present and clean -> CANDIDATE
all nine promotion gates pass -> VALIDATING
held-out replay tracks research, hash + parity -> PAPER
null rolling IC (too few buckets): no evidence
uninformative re-read of a breach: no evidence

transition.reason: persistent breach: 6 consecutive evals below watch gate 0.0

LC01.note: SYSTEM advance on a RETIRED alpha: terminal, no movement

LC02.note: re-run shows leakage: leakage_clean fails -> demoted to RESEARCH

transition.reason: leakage_clean failed: a leaking alpha is not a candidate

LC02.note: leaking result at RESEARCH: ledger passes, leakage fails, hold
no evidence at RESEARCH: presence gate fails (value null), hold

LC03.note: validation block absent: silence, counter unchanged

transition.reason: 3 consecutive failed evaluations (max 3); failed gates: paper_min_sessions, paper_ic_tracking, paper_net_pnl, no_kill_events

LC03.reason: manual retirement: hypothesis withdrawn by the desk

transition.reason: manual retirement: hypothesis withdrawn by the desk
